test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A person who is never happy with what he has
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Malcontent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Malcontent"** refers to a person who is dissatisfied and rebellious. (असंतुष्ट व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **He was known as a malcontent constantly complaining about everything at work.
 
 
 
• Hence, a malcontent is someone who is never happy with what he has.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Malcontent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Heresy **(धर्म-विरोधी मत): Belief or opinion contrary to orthodox religious doctrine.

 
 
• **Example: **He was burned at the stake for heresy in medieval times.
 
 
 
• **Malleable **(लचीला): Easily influenced or pliable.
 
 
• **Example: **Gold is a malleable metal that can be shaped into different forms.
 
 
 
• **Miser** (कंजूस): A person who hoards wealth and spends as little money as possible.
 
 
• **Example:** The old miser would not even part with a single penny for charity.
